gyroflightHomeTagline.message: Flight controller configuration, blackbox analysis and safe tuning

gyroflightHomeConnectText.message: Plug in the flight controller and use Connect at the top of the sidebar to configure it.

gyroflightHomeBlackboxText.message: Open a blackbox log and inspect it.

gyroflightHomeFlasherText.message: Flash Betaflight firmware to a flight controller.

gyroflightHomeAutotuneText.message: Analyse a CHIRP log: Gyroflight qualifies every sweep and builds one global tune. Writing a tune to a craft is locked for now.

gyroflightHomeAutotuneExpert.message: Autotune is available in Expert Mode (Options).

gyroflightHomeAttribution.message: Gyroflight is based on the Betaflight App and distributed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

gyroflightIntro.message: Gyroflight is built on the Betaflight App. Its Redline Dynamics analysis and safety engine adds CHIRP measurement qualification, a global tune and safety checks on top of Betaflight's own tools, which are used as they are.

gyroflightCapGlobalTune.message: Gyroflight global tune: merge and axis coverage

gyroflightCapSafetyFullDetail.message: Needs analysis evidence Gyroflight does not have yet, so Safety blocks every tune.

gyroflightCapPhysicalApply.message: Writing a tune to the flight controller

gyroflightCapPhysicalApplyDetail.message: Deliberately disabled until Safety is complete.

gyroflightCapTuneSession.message: Tune session: local storage, Flight A/B selection and cross-flight comparison

gyroflightCapTuneSessionDetail.message: Tune Sessions can be saved locally. Flight A/B selection and cross-flight comparison are implemented; comparisons are diagnostic only. Repeatability is not proven; Verified Tuning and physical Apply remain locked.

gyroflightAttribution.message: Gyroflight is based on the Betaflight App by the Betaflight open source project and is distributed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

gyrocoreChirpIntro.message: Every CHIRP sweep in every embedded log, decoded with the Blackbox Viewer parser and checked by Gyroflight before Betaflight Autotune may recommend or apply gains. Betaflight computes the transfer function and the recommendation; Gyroflight decides whether the measurement is valid for tuning and whether Apply is allowed.

gyrocoreChirpStateNoChirpText.message: No CHIRP sweep was found in any of the $1 embedded logs.

gyrocoreChirpStateRejectedText.message: CHIRP was found, but no measurement is valid for tuning.

gyrocoreChirpStateWarnText.message: At least one measurement is valid for tuning, with warnings.

gyrocoreChirpStateUsableText.message: At least one measurement is valid for tuning.

gyrocoreChirpNoChirpError.message: No CHIRP sweep found in any of the $1 embedded logs.

gyrocoreChirpRejectedError.message: CHIRP found, but no measurement is valid for tuning and none could be analysed. See Gyroflight CHIRP qualification below.

gyrocoreChirpDiagnosticOnly.message: Diagnostic only — not valid for tuning

gyrocoreChirpDiagnosticAxes.message: Diagnostic only — not valid for tuning: $1. These plots are shown for inspection; no gains are recommended from them.

gyrocoreApplyNoAxis.message: Apply Gains is blocked: no measurement in this log is valid for tuning.

gyrocoreReason_non_uniform_sampling.message: Timestamps are not uniform: only $1% of sample intervals are within ±10% of the median (needs 90%), or time runs backwards.

gyrocoreReason_excessive_gaps.message: Significant timestamp gaps: about $1% of samples missing in $2 gaps (limit 1%).

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_crosscheck.message: Sample rate not confirmed by timestamps (status: $1).

gyrocoreReason_insufficient_samples.message: Not enough data: $1, needs at least $2.

gyrocoreReason_insufficient_excitation.message: Insufficient excitation: setpoint RMS $1 is below $2.

gyrocoreReason_unusable_frequency_range.message: Unusable frequency coverage: $1 usable frequency bins, needs $2.

gyrocoreReason_no_transfer_function.message: No transfer function could be computed from this sweep.

gyrocoreReason_chirp_band_unknown_defaul.message: CHIRP band not in the log header; 5–100 Hz assumed.

gyrocoreReason_chirp_band_near_nyquist.message: CHIRP band ends at $1 Hz, near the Nyquist limit ($2 Hz).

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_contract_mism.message: Sample-rate contract invalid: header rate and timestamp rate disagree.

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_contract_time.message: Sample-rate contract invalid: the log has no usable rate headers, so the rate comes from timestamps only.

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_contract_head.message: Sample-rate contract invalid: the header rate could not be checked against timestamps.

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_contract_unus.message: Sample-rate contract invalid: no trustworthy sample rate.

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_contract_unkn.message: Sample-rate contract invalid: the sample rate is unknown.

gyrocoreReason_sample_rate_contract_beta.message: Sample-rate contract invalid: Betaflight's header-only rate ($1 Hz) differs from the measured rate ($2 Hz).

gyrocoreReason_current_tune_missing.message: Current $1 slider is not in the log header, so the current tune cannot be represented.

gyrocoreReason_current_tune_unparseable.message: Current $1 slider in the log header cannot be read.

gyrocoreReason_current_tune_zero.message: Current $1 slider is 0 in the log header (Betaflight would silently assume 100).

gyrocoreReason_simplified_pids_mode_off.message: Simplified (slider) PID mode is OFF in this log: the sliders do not set the PIDs the recommendation is for.

gyrocoreReason_simplified_pids_mode_unkn.message: Simplified (slider) PID mode is not recorded in this log, so the recommendation cannot be shown to reach the PIDs.

gyrocoreReason_yaw_not_under_slider_cont.message: Simplified PID mode is RP: yaw is not under slider control.

gyrocoreReason_simplified_dterm_filter_u.message: Simplified D-term filter mode is not recorded in this log.

gyrocoreReason_simplified_dterm_filter_o.message: Simplified D-term filter is OFF: the D-term filter slider has no effect.

gyrocoreReason_recommendation_not_produc.message: No recommendation: the measurement is not valid for tuning.

gyrocoreReason_slider_clamp_changes_dire.message: $1: the recommendation asks for $2 → $3 ($4), but the 25–250 slider limit turns it into $5 ($6).

gyrocoreReason_slider_clamp_material.message: $1: the recommendation asks for $2 → $3, but the 25–250 slider limit turns it into $5.

gyrocoreReason_slider_non_finite.message: $1: the recommendation is not a finite number.

gyrocoreReason_slider_clamped.message: $1: requested $3 was limited to $5 by the slider range.

gyrocoreReason_autotune_sensitivity_boun.message: No slider value keeps peak sensitivity within the robustness bound: the craft is fragile beyond what one pass can repair.
Robustness (peak sensitivity), not the phase-margin target, limits the gain.

gyrocoreReason_autotune_target_margin_un.message: The phase-margin target is not reachable; the gain is held.

gyrocoreReason_autotune_no_open_loop_cro.message: No open-loop crossover inside the coherent band.

gyrocoreReason_phase_margin_not_validate.message: Phase margin is not validated: L = T/(1−T) assumes unity feedback, but Betaflight uses D on the gyro and feedforward on the setpoint. PID recommendations from that margin are blocked.

gyrocoreReason_autotune_gain_clamped_per.message: The gain change is limited by the per-pass range.

gyrocoreReason_apply_unknown_measurement.message: The selected axis has no qualified measurement.

gyrocoreReason_apply_sliders_differ_from.message: The sliders to apply are not the ones recommended for the qualified measurement.

gyrocoreReason_fc_simplified_pids_mode_o.message: The connected flight controller has simplified (slider) PID mode OFF.

gyrocoreReason_fc_simplified_pids_mode_u.message: The connected flight controller's simplified PID mode could not be read.

gyrocoreReason_fc_live_readback_missing.message: The connected flight controller's live slider state could not be read back, so nothing was written.

gyrocoreReason_fc_yaw_not_under_slider_c.message: The connected flight controller's slider mode is RP: yaw is not under slider control.

gyrocoreReason_fc_missing_axis_evidence.message: The connected flight controller's slider mode drives $1, but the global recommendation has no qualified measurement for that axis.

gyrocoreReason_fc_axis_coverage_mode_off.message: The connected flight controller has simplified (slider) PID mode OFF.

gyrocoreReason_fc_axis_coverage_mode_unk.message: The connected flight controller's simplified PID mode could not be read.

gyrocoreReason_log_malformed_rows_skippe.message: Some frames of this log could not be read and were skipped.

gyrocoreReason_log_flight_mode_flags_col.message: The log has no flight-mode flags, so CHIRP was detected from debug[1] alone.

gyrocoreReason_log_chirp_mode_flag_unava.message: CHIRP detected from debug[1] alone (no CHIRP mode flag in the log).

gyrocoreReason_log_chirp_frequency_range.message: The CHIRP frequency range is not in the log header.

gyrocoreReason_log_chirp_axis_out_of_ran.message: Frames with an invalid CHIRP axis in debug[1] were dropped.

gyrocoreChirpDiagnosticBanner.message: Diagnostic only — not valid for tuning: $1. Gyroflight rejected these measurements; the plots below are for inspection and no gains are recommended from them.

gyrocoreGlobalIntro.message: Simplified tuning sliders are global: one value applies to every axis the slider mode covers. The per-axis recommendations below are evidence. Only this global recommendation, merged by Gyroflight from the qualified axes of one log, can be applied.

gyrocoreGlobalNone.message: No global recommendation: this log has no CHIRP measurement with a logged slider tune.

gyrocoreGlobalBlocked.message: Why the global recommendation cannot be applied:

gyrocoreGlobalRole_excluded_by_axis_gate.message: left out (axis not under slider control)

gyrocoreGlobalRole_not_selected.message: not used (another sweep of this axis was chosen)

gyrocoreApplyNoComposite.message: Apply Gains is blocked: there is no valid global recommendation.

gyrocoreGlobal_unresolved_merge_requires.message: The axes do not agree on one global slider set (Gyroflight merge requires review).

gyrocoreGlobal_slider_disagreement.message: Axes propose different values for $1; Gyroflight does not average or pick one.

gyrocoreGlobal_no_participating_axes.message: No axis is eligible to contribute to a global recommendation.

gyrocoreGlobal_system_id_unusable_any.message: At least one axis has no usable measurement: its CHIRP evidence failed qualification (listed below).

gyrocoreGlobal_system_id_unusable.message: An axis has no usable measurement $1; its CHIRP evidence failed qualification.

gyrocoreGlobal_repeated_axis_requires_se.message: $1 has more than one qualified sweep. Choose one explicitly in the CHIRP qualification table; Gyroflight has no rule to pick for you.

gyrocoreGlobal_missing_axis_evidence.message: The slider mode drives $1, but no qualified, selected measurement of that axis is in this log. The sliders are global, so every axis they drive needs its own evidence.

gyrocoreGlobal_axis_coverage_mode_off.message: Simplified (slider) PID mode is OFF in this log: the sliders drive no axis.

gyrocoreGlobal_axis_coverage_mode_unknow.message: The log does not record the simplified PID mode, so the axes the sliders drive are unknown.

gyrocoreSafetyNotEvaluated.message: There is no valid global recommendation, so Safety cannot authorize a tune. The reasons are in the Global tune box above.

gyrocoreSafetyNoAnalysis.message: Gyroflight Safety needs analysis evidence (motor diagnostics, noise, resonance, problems, confidence, quality) that Gyroflight does not provide yet, so it cannot authorize this tune.

gyrocoreSafety_safe_tune_candidate_block.message: No safe-tune candidate could be formed.

gyrocoreSafety_missing_required_pid_or_f.message: The log does not record the current PID/filter values needed as a baseline: $1

gyrocoreSafety_proposal_blocked.message: The absolute tune proposal is blocked.

gyrocoreSafety_unresolved_merge_requires.message: The axes do not agree on one global slider set.

gyrocoreSafety_system_id_unusable.message: An axis's system identification is unusable.

gyrocoreSafety_invalid_simplified_tuning.message: The proposed slider state is incomplete, so its PIDs cannot be checked.

gyrocoreQv2DiagnosticNote.message: Diagnostics only. These values are not used to authorize tuning; only the qualification gates above decide.

gyrocoreQv2RejectedNote.message: This CHIRP failed existing qualification gates. Bode and support data below remain for inspection and are not a validated plant response.

gyrocoreQv2Support_COHERENT.message: In sweep · input relative power · coherent (diagnostic, not proven ID)

gyrocoreQv2Support_WEAK_COHERENCE.message: In sweep · input relative power · weak coherence (diagnostic)

gyrocoreAbIntro.message: Choose two Flights from a saved Tune Session and check whether they can be compared: independent recordings, the same firmware and the same Quality V2 analysis version. This only selects and checks the pair; it does not compare tuning results.

gyrocoreAbNotVerifiedTune.message: An A/B selection is not a Verified Tune. It does not qualify CHIRPs, prove repeatability, approve PID settings or release Safety, and physical Apply stays locked ($1).

gyrocoreAbSessionsError.message: Saved sessions could not be read ($1).

gyrocoreAbSessionsEmpty.message: No Tune Sessions saved on this device yet. Analyse a CHIRP log above and save it as a session.

gyrocoreAbSessionCorrupt.message: Session $1 is damaged and cannot be opened. It is left as it is.

gyrocoreAbSessionUnsupported.message: Session $1 was saved in a format this version does not support. It is left as it is.

gyrocoreAbSessionProblem.message: This session cannot be used: $1 ($2). Nothing was repaired or removed.

gyrocoreAbSave_nothing_to_save.message: Nothing to save: no log of this analysis has a valid Flight identity. $1

gyrocoreAbFlightsTooFew.message: Only $1 selectable Flight(s): an A/B pair needs two.

gyrocoreAbPair_INCOMPLETE.message: Choose Flight A and Flight B

gyrocoreAbSaveAlreadyPresent.message: Not saved: this analysis contains a Flight that is already in the open session ($1). The stored Flight was left unchanged. Use “Save analysis as new session” to keep this analysis separately.

gyrocoreAbSaveNotOpened.message: It was not opened, because another session was opened or closed while saving.

gyrocoreCfcNotVerifiedTune.message: Diagnostic comparison only. This is not a Verified Tune: it proves no repeatability, approves no PID or filter values, grants no tuning authorization and releases no Apply ($1 stays in force).

gyrocoreCfcStatus_INCOMPLETE.message: Choose Flight A and Flight B

gyrocoreCfcStatus_NOT_COMPARABLE.message: No CHIRP pair can be compared

gyrocoreCfcIncomplete.message: Choose Flight A and Flight B in an open Tune Session to compare their measurements.

gyrocoreCfcBlocked.message: The A/B pair is blocked, so no measurement of these Flights is compared. Blocking reasons:

gyrocoreCfcConfigNote.message: Compared as logged in the BBL headers. A setting that was not logged stays UNKNOWN; no firmware default is filled in. Any logged difference, or a setting logged by one Flight only, keeps the numeric differences closed.

gyrocoreCfcConfigConfounder.message: Logged settings differ ($1). This may explain differences between the measurements, or confound them; it does not prove cause and effect.

gyrocoreCfcConfigNotConditions.message: Matching settings do not show that motors, propellers, battery, weather or other flight conditions were the same.

gyrocoreCfcAxisNone.message: No CHIRP of this axis in either Flight.

gyrocoreCfcChartMagnitude.message: Magnitude (dB), usable bins, Flight A and Flight B

gyrocoreCfcChartMagnitudeDelta.message: Magnitude difference (dB) = Flight B − Flight A

gyrocoreCfcChartCoherence.message: Coherence, bins with input power, Flight A and Flight B

gyrocoreCfcChartCoherenceDelta.message: Coherence difference = Flight B − Flight A

gyrocoreCfcChartAxesDeltaDb.message: x: frequency (Hz, log) · y: B − A (dB); dashed: 0

gyrocoreCfcChartAxesDeltaCoherence.message: x: frequency (Hz, log) · y: B − A; dashed: 0

gyrocoreCfcChartEmpty.message: No shared valid bins to draw.

gyrocoreCfcSeriesDelta.message: B − A, only where both bins are valid; gaps are not compared

gyrocoreCfcSummary.message: $1 bins, $2–$3 Hz: lowest $4 at $5 Hz, highest $6 at $7 Hz, mean absolute $8.

gyrocoreCfcSummaryNone.message: No shared valid bins: no difference.

gyrocoreCfcUnmatchedBins.message: Bins stored by one CHIRP only (A $1, B $2) are not compared.

gyrocoreCfcDiagnosticsHead.message: What this comparison does and does not show

gyrocoreCfcInterpretation.message: Differences are facts, not verdicts: a lower magnitude or a higher coherence is not better by itself. Relative spectral power is not compared between Flights (it is not a calibrated PSD). No PID values are recommended here.

gyrocoreM4Title.message: Gyroflight M4 — feedforward, D-term and filters (measurement only)

gyrocoreM4Intro.message: Open any blackbox log (.bbl) to measure stick tracking, D-term effectiveness and gyro / RPM / notch filter evidence. The file is decoded with the Blackbox Viewer parser, every embedded log is analysed separately, and missing signals are listed instead of being filled in.

gyrocoreM4NoApply.message: Measurement only: no PID, feedforward or filter values are recommended, nothing is written to the flight controller, and Apply stays disabled.

gyrocoreM4FfChirpBlocked.message: This log contains (or may contain) a CHIRP sweep: it is not used for stick feedforward evaluation. Tracking numbers below are diagnostics against the sweep setpoint only.

gyrocoreM4NoMissing.message: All signals and filter headers read by M4 are present.

gyrocoreM4FfChirpExcluded.message: CHIRP sweeps in this log (plus a guard band) are excluded from feedforward: only CHIRP-free acro stick segments are used.

gyrocoreM4Segments.message: Flight segments (inferred from arm box + throttle; motor output is not used)

gyrocoreM4Unsegmented.message: Flight segmentation not possible — no stick, spectrum or eRPM measurement

gyroflightWorkflowTitle.message: Tune workflow: analyze, calculate, compare, apply, verify, restore

gyroflightWorkflowIntro.message: What the analysis produced for each part of the tune, what is still missing, and the exact change Apply would write. Nothing is written until you confirm the full change; every write is read back and only saved when it matches.

gyroflightAnalyzeMissing.message: no CHIRP log imported yet (Import Blackbox Log above)

gyroflightAnalyzeM4Missing.message: not analysed yet (Open BBL for M4 analysis above)

gyroflightCompareNone.message: No global recommendation to compare yet.

gyroflightV2ProfileNote.message: PID profile $1 is active on the flight controller. PID, feedforward, D-max, D-term and slider values are written to that profile only; gyro, dynamic notch and RPM filter values are global and apply to every profile. The write stops if the active profile changes.

gyroflightCompareByFc.message: calculated by the flight controller at Apply

gyroflightCheck_composite.message: Qualified global recommendation (incl. the phase-margin validation)

gyroflightCheck_release.message: Release conditions (Safety analysis evidence, independent PID validation)

gyroflightCheck_connection.message: Connected to a real flight controller

gyroflightApplyOnClick.message: On the click, Gyroflight also checks that the connected craft is the logged one (UID, board, firmware), that it is disarmed and still has the logged tune, and stores a backup before writing.

gyroflightApplyProcedure.message: A backup of the current tune is stored first. After writing, every value is read back and compared with what the flight controller calculated; it is saved to EEPROM only when everything matches.

gyroflightVerifyNone.message: Nothing applied or restored in this session.

gyroflightVerifiedApply.message: Applied: every value read back matched, and it was saved to EEPROM.

gyroflightVerifiedRestore.message: Restored: every value read back matched the backup, and it was saved to EEPROM.

gyroflightApplyBlocked.message: Not applied: a check failed before anything was written.

gyroflightApplyFailed.message: The write did not complete. This is not a successful Apply.

gyroflightNothingSaved.message: Nothing was saved to EEPROM; the saved tune is the previous one. Power-cycle the flight controller or use Restore to clear the unsaved values.

gyroflightMaybeSaved.message: The write stopped at $1; it is unknown whether it was saved. Reconnect, check the values, and use Restore if needed.

gyroflightRestoreConnect.message: Connect the flight controller to see the backups taken from it.

gyroflightRestoreNone.message: No backups from this flight controller in this browser.

gyroflightRestoreConfirmText.message: Write the backup from $1 ($2, firmware $3) back to this flight controller. The current tune is backed up first; the result is read back and saved only when it matches the backup.

gyroflightPreviewValues.message: Values the flight controller calculated for this change (current -> after Apply):

gyroflightPreviewOk.message: Read from the connected flight controller; nothing was written. Values it holds now and would hold after Apply:

gyroflightPreviewBlocked.message: The preview could not be read; nothing was written.

gyroflightV2Title.message: Autotune engine v2: absolute PID, feedforward and filters

gyroflightV2Intro.message: Calculates absolute P/I/D, feedforward, gyro and D-term lowpass, RPM filter and dynamic notch values from your CHIRP logs. Every part shows whether it is validated and which measurement it still needs. Only validated values under a complete release contract can be applied, and only when you click Apply.

gyroflightV2NoSource.message: Import a blackbox log with CHIRP sweeps above; it is listed here for the calculation.

gyroflightV2NoChirp.message: No CHIRP measurement with a transfer function in these logs.

gyroflightV2NotValidatedNote.message: Values that are not VALIDATED stay visible here but are never written.

gyroflightV2Cond_measurement.message: Qualified CHIRP measurement on every changed axis

gyroflightV2Cond_model_quality.message: Filter chain, D path and plant validated on the logs

gyroflightV2Cond_phase_margin.message: Predicted phase margin validated and above target

gyroflightV2Cond_robustness.message: Predicted gain margin and sensitivity peak inside target

gyroflightV2Cond_independent_validation.message: Independent flight confirmed the prediction (Verified Tune)

gyroflightV2Cond_items_validated.message: Every value to write is itself validated

gyroflightV2Cond_fc_identity.message: Checked when you click: same craft, board and firmware, disarmed

gyroflightV2Cond_current_config.message: Checked when you click: the flight controller still holds the logged values

gyroflightV2Cond_readback.message: Checked when you click: every value reads back as written, before and after saving

gyroflightV2ApplyConfirmText.message: These values will be written to the flight controller. Simplified tuning is switched off first, so it cannot recalculate them. A backup of every value is stored and can be restored.

gyroflightV2ApplyProcedure.message: After writing, every value is read back; it is saved to EEPROM only when all match, and read back again after saving.

gyroflightV2RebootRequired.message: The flight controller asks for a reboot before the new filter settings take full effect.

gyroflightV2Saved_no.message: Nothing was saved: the previous settings are still the saved ones.

gyroflightV2Saved_unknown.message: It is not known whether the change was saved. Read the settings again before flying.

gyroflightV2Saved_yes_adjusted.message: Saved, but the firmware changed some values when it reloaded them.

gyroflightV2PartialWrite.message: Now different from the backup on the flight controller:

gyroflightV2Need_acro_stick_flight.message: an acro flight with stick moves (rolls, flips, at least 3 s, CHIRP off)

gyroflightV2Need_ab_flight_with_proposal.message: a flight with the proposed settings to compare against this one

gyroflightV2Need_ab_stick_flight_with_pr.message: an acro stick flight with the proposed feedforward

gyroflightV2Need_fft_freq_debug_flight_f.message: a flight with debug_mode FFT_FREQ (dynamic notch centres)

gyroflightV2Need_second_chirp_flight_sam.message: a second CHIRP flight with the same tune

gyroflightV2Need_chirp_roll_meeting_qual.message: a roll CHIRP that passes qualification (coherence)
